audit.why: Melee scaler who farms safely inside Hallowed Mist. Aatrox owns the early levels and must convert before her on-hit items come online.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: Needlework (R) is 120/100/80 and casts up to three times, slowing each throw. World Ender matches it at 120/100/80, so the level-6 fight is decided by whether she has Hallowed Mist up.
audit.corrected: Needlework (R) is three throws on 120s, and Hallowed Mist (W, 22s) makes her untargetable from outside. Step into the mist or wait — never spend World Ender into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist (W, 22/21/20/19/18) makes her untargetable from outside the zone — step inside or wait it out rather than spending your commit into it. Skip 'n Slash (E, 13/12.5/12/11.5/11) is her dash; Infernal Chains grounds it.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Gwen. Infernal Chains (W) grounds and drags her back to the centre if she stays in the zone — hold it for Skip 'n Slash (E, 13s at rank 1). Hallowed Mist (W, 22s) blocks targeting from outside, so walk into the mist instead of dumping your combo at the edge. Save R for the commit.
